panels.title: Up
panels.description: 1 when EL and beacon endpoints are healthy, contract addresses are resolved and the last iteration had no failures.

panels.title: Processing lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest stream cursor block.

panels.title: Last processed block
panels.description: Lowest processed block over all log streams.

panels.title: Last processed slot
panels.description: Slot of the last processed block.

panels.title: Since key set refresh
panels.description: Time since the last fully successful key set refresh.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Exporter version.

panels.title: Stream cursors
panels.description: Last processed block per log stream.

panels.title: Endpoints
panels.description: Configured endpoints in config order of each kind (el = execution, cl = beacon). Head is the block number (el) or head slot (cl); lag is the distance to the best endpoint of the same kind. An endpoint is DOWN when it is unreachable, syncing or lags more than max_endpoint_lag.

panels.title: Endpoint errors
panels.description: Errors per endpoint and reason. range_limit (request split on the same endpoint) and not_found (block not yet known, next endpoint asked) are expected occasionally.

panels.title: Used keys (all time)
panels.description: Used keys of the key set (Keys API used=true plus static pubkeys).

panels.title: Keys ever deposited
panels.description: Keys with a stored deposit or found on the beacon chain.

panels.title: Credentials mismatch
panels.description: Initial deposits whose withdrawal credentials do not point to the expected withdrawal vault (top-ups are not checked, the beacon chain ignores their credentials).

panels.title: Initial deposits 24h
panels.description: Initial deposits with a block time in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Top-ups 24h
panels.description: Top-up deposits with a block time in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Deposited ETH 24h
panels.description: ETH of initial deposits and top-ups with a block time in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Deposit events
panels.description: Initial deposits and top-ups per scrape interval.

panels.title: Deposited ETH
panels.description: Deposited ETH per kind.

panels.title: Deposit events per key
panels.description: One row per key with deposit events seen in the deposit lookback window or later (older events are not scanned). Initial deposit columns are empty for keys whose initial deposit happened before that window; credentials are only checked for initial deposits.

targets.expr: max by (pubkey, validator_index, set) ({__name__=~"lido_keys_deposit_timestamp_seconds|lido_keys_topup_last_timestamp_seconds", set=~"$set", module_id=~"$module_id", operator_id=~"$operator_id"}) * 1000

panels.title: Open exit requests
panels.description: Keys with an exit request that are not exiting on the beacon chain yet.

panels.title: Exit requests 24h
panels.description: Lido exit requests with a block time in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Open exit requests
panels.description: Requests stay open until the validator is exiting on the beacon chain. Colours: yellow from 2h (response time), orange from 48h, red from 84h (alert thresholds are set via LKE_EXIT_RESPONSE_HOURS / LKE_EXIT_WARN_HOURS / LKE_EXIT_CRIT_HOURS).

panels.title: Exit requests
panels.description: Lido exit requests for the monitored keys.

panels.title: Triggered exits 24h
panels.description: EIP-7002 full exit requests with a block time in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Partial withdrawals 24h
panels.description: EIP-7002 partial withdrawal requests with a block time in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Unexpected source 24h
panels.description: EIP-7002 requests of the last 24 hours from a source not named lido*.

panels.title: By source
panels.description: Requests per source and kind (total since the lookback window).

panels.title: Triggered exits and partials by source
Requested partial withdrawal amount
panels.description: Requested amount of partial withdrawals in ETH (counter in gwei).
